name: Cotswolds
about: Comfortable to visit almost any time outside the depths of winter.
overview: Honey-stone villages, thatched cottages and gentle rolling hills between Oxford and Bath — a leisurely, pastoral counterpoint to the Lake District or Highlands.
costOverview: The Cotswolds run pricier than much of rural England — a proper pub lunch or cream tea costs a real premium in these postcard villages, and taxis between villages add up fast given the distances involved.
